distinguishing_features: Uses embedded conductive interlayers to grade the bushing’s electric field rather than monitoring insulation condition.
Targets field redistribution within the insulation, not an operational alarm or predictive diagnostic.
parsed.objective_technical_problem: Reduce local electric-field peaks in HVDC bushing insulation that can contribute to tracking under contamination.
parsed.viable_reason: The stated field reduction is miscalculated (the first section is about 11.6 kV/mm, not 1.16 kV/mm), and floating layers do not ensure equal voltage division at steady DC or prevent external contamination tracking.
parsed.non_obvious_reason: Conductive or semiconductive stress grading is a routine field-control approach, so applying it to redistribute fields in bushing insulation would be an obvious engineering step.
